Sanne came back with 766 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Raj came back with 325 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
🍽️ Elif taps the pantry's fullest jar. "More than we can eat before it turns. Rendering fat instead — the lamps won't fill themselves."
🍽️ Elif taps the pantry door — full to bursting — and keeps the day's share in hand. "Dinner's on me tonight, then."
🤒 Sanne is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse.
Raj sits with Sanne — cool cloth, bitter tea, watching the breathing.

🌙 Raid — Emberhold came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~1000 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 2). You can function through terror. Your hands shake but they work. This is a trained skill.
📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 2). The shot is always there. You just wait.
